maya: Heads-up: onboarding zeta-7b weights — HF snapshot shows a different manifest SHA than our S3 mirror. quick sync?
alex: can you drop the HF + S3 paths? i'll try a quick diff.
maya: HF: https://huggingface.co/redwood/zeta-7b/commit/abcd1234 -> manifest.json sha256: d3b07384d113edec49eaa6238ad5ff00
maya: S3: s3://redwood-models/zeta-7b/v1/manifest.json sha256: 9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015
sam: ugh, looks like partial re-upload. sync-job log shows 206/400 MB failed. pinging infra-bot.
infra-bot: sync-job-99: ERROR 206 PartialContent at s3://redwood-models/zeta-7b/v1/weights.bin -> retry scheduled (runbook: check presign + byte-range retry). See https://internal.jobs/99
lee: tokenizer files OK? sometimes vocab vs tokenizer version mismatch causes serving to blow up even if weights are fine.
maya: quick check: HF tokenizer.json version "v2", S3 has tokenizer.json "v1". also vocab size mismatch: 50256 vs 50000. that'll cause runtime align issues.
sam: can we re-mirror tokenizer + manifest? or reingest from HF origin? presign TTL and access logs are a concern.
alex: short plan: (1) pause traffic to dedicated pool for zeta-7b canary, (2) trigger mirror retry with full-range get, (3) validate sha256 and tokenizer diff, (4) if mismatch, reingest from HF and rotate manifest tag.
maya: +1. i'll take step 1 and 3. sam, can you coordinate mirror retry with infra?
sam: on it. running:
`curl -o /tmp/weights.bin "https://huggingface.co/redwood/zeta-7b/resolve/abcd1234/weights.bin?raw=true"`
`sha256sum /tmp/weights.bin`
I'll post results in ~15m.
lee: when re-ingesting, ensure manifest schema 2.1 (loader updated last month) and add \"orig_source\": \"hf://redwood/zeta-7b@abcd1234\" in manifest metadata.
maya: noted. also watch presign TTL — last time we had a 5m presign which caused incomplete transfers. set to 1h for the retry.
alex: i'll open a short PR to pin tokenizer v2 in our registry if HF is canonical. tagging @ops for visibility.
maya: thanks team :thumbsup:
infra-bot: deploy-pause: canary routes for zeta-7b paused by maya at 1717007800
sam: checksum matched locally (sha256: d3b07384d113edec49eaa6238ad5ff00) — S3 object still old. retry succeeded, reingest in progress.
maya: reingest done, tokenizer v2 copied, manifest updated with new sha256 and orig_source. unpausing canary in 10.
alex: unpaused — rolling canary healthy. closing this thread, will file followup doc for a short postmortem.
_meta: generated for dataset — slack thread representing engineering coordination on weights sourcing, tokenizer quirks, checksum and mirror retry
